A '''hospital ship''' or '''medical frigate''' was a medical [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] often accompanying large or medium-sized military fleets to provide back-up in battle, though it was also sometimes found without military company. Hospital ships were mobile [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] equipped with medical gear, such as [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]] and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]].

==History==
The craft were many and varied, including modified [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] such as [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigates]] and [[Sprint-class rescue craft/Legends|''Sprint''-class rescue craft]], including ''[[Bright Flight]]''.

''MedStar''-class frigates functioned both as medical transport ships and hospital ships during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], being manned by top class [[Medic/Legends|medics]] and, in some cases, also [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]]. [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] were used as well during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] with the ''MedStar''-class frigate.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates, and at least one [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]], were sometimes converted into hospital ships, by gutting the internal hangar bay out to make room for an internal hospital. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was healed aboard such a converted Nebulon-B frigate after having lost his hand by the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

Another former military vessel converted into a hospital ship was the [[Mercy (hospital ship)|''Mercy'']], a two-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spaceship, appropriated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> It was this ship that received casualties from the [[Attack on Shackel|attack]] on [[Shackel]]; aboard this ship [[Kyle Katarn]] was healed in [[Ward 114]]'s [[bacta tank 23]] after having been injured during his [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|second mission]] to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>

Another famous hospital ship was the ''[[Sudden Restoration]]''. Manned by [[Carosite]] [[Doctor/Legends|physicians]], it offered free health care to all, and often worked in [[Star system/Legends|systems]] ravaged by recent battles. Hospital ships were also utilized heavily by the [[New Republic Relief Corps]].
